A2 two players plus a non-playing GM have three distinct public playerIds across isolated profiles through ordinary shipped UI
A3 stable across reload/reconnect (and authority restart, identity strict)
A4 renewal and expired-token recovery on the installed app
A5 operator revoke / re-provision and guest re-claim (S5 amended by G5)
A6 no E2E identity seeding, manual bearer transfer, global active-row switching or second server; seat selection grants no role; no plaintext password/private-key persistence
A7 revocation effective at the next mint or renewal, not immediate eviction
A8 CF-LSC2OP-4 autofill attributes (interactive check recorded as a human gap) and CF-SMOKEA1-7 restart observation

scenarioInventory.note: Frozen from the proof spec section 3 (premises re-checked above). scenarios.title: Installed artifact identity and clean single authority (Windows only)
steps: Require win32 and LSC2P_INSTALLER, LSC2P_INSTALLER_SHA256, LSC2P_INSTALL_DIR, LSC2P_RC_SHA, LSC2P_RUN_DIR (missing = FAIL, not skip); self-skip only when LSC2P_PACKAGED !== "1".
Stream-hash the installer; cross-check the operator hash; filename must match ^MekStation-.+-win-x64\.exe$.
Record Authenticode status (expected NotSigned).
Exactly one TCP listener on 3001 bound to 127.0.0.1, image path under LSC2P_INSTALL_DIR ending MekStation.exe; no listener on 3600.
Record installed exe SHA-256 and ProductVersion.
GET /api/multiplayer/auth/local-seats: two seats, both unprovisioned, generation 0.
scenarios.expect: Installer and installed-exe hashes recorded by the spec itself; fresh authority.
scenarios.failsIf: win-unpacked or plain node as the listener; more than one listener; non-loopback bind; any active seat (authority not fresh); hash mismatch; port 3600 open.

scenarios.title: Three identities through the ordinary UI
steps: GM profile: /settings -> Vault & Sharing -> Create Your Vault Identity (display name, random password).
GM: /gameplay/campaigns, create-coop-password-input, "Create Co-op Campaign"; capture the 6-character room code.
GM operator panel "Manage local seats": provision local-seat-1 (label "Player 1") and local-seat-2 (label "Player 2") with Primary vault password + New seat password.
P1 and P2 profiles: open the join dialog, choose Local seat 1 / Local seat 2 in "This browser profile joins as", join with the room code and the seat password.
Read each public binding {matchId, choice, playerId} from sessionStorage mekstation.coopCredential.joined.<matchId>.
scenarios.expect: Three pairwise-distinct pid_ ids; seat ids equal the operator list and the public GET; coop-session-badge on all three; host surfaces only on the GM; three screenshots.
scenarios.failsIf: Any two ids equal; GM id equal to a seat id; provisioning or joining needs a non-UI call; a wrong password joins; the run needs /api/e2e/*, a pasted bearer, DB edits or a pre-seeded vault identity.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: Selectors frozen below. The chooser is mounted inside the join dialog (CampaignCoopEntryPanel.tsx:457); the GM create path uses the password box, not the chooser. Guests are admitted by the host when a tactical seat is free; there is no GM admission control (Q8).

scenarios.title: Reload and reconnect keep identity
steps: a. page.reload() on each profile: same binding and playerId, no password field, zero mint POSTs (sessionStorage survives reload in the same tab).
b. Transport drop through page.routeWebSocket pass-through then close the page side: reconnect with the stored bearer, same playerId, no mint POST, no password prompt.

c. P2 only: a second tab in the same profile has no bearer, keeps the localStorage choice, shows the BINDING_REQUIRED text and an explicit reclaim path; re-mint with the same password gives the same playerId. Never on GM or P1 (their bearers feed S3).
scenarios.expect: Same playerIds throughout; a new tab never inherits another tab bearer.
scenarios.failsIf: A playerId changes; a prompt appears after a plain reload; a mint POST without a user submit; a second tab inherits a bearer.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: S2b depends on LSC-2 reconnect behavior and routeWebSocket (U6); if the page-side close does not reconnect, S2b is rewritten as an authority restart (S7 already does one). Probe G-P2.

scenarios.title: Renewal and expiry (real-time soak, tag @soak, about 62 minutes from T0)
steps: Read expiresAt for GM and P1 with a public-only evaluate (a number, never the token).
Poll every 15 s with no input: no prompt before expiresAt - 4 min - 5 s and zero mint POSTs before the submit.

GM: the "Co-op sign-in renewal and recovery" region appears within 30 s after expiresAt - 4 min, on the dashboard and one of missions/log/personnel; enter the GM password; expect later expiresAt, same playerId and a new WebSocket (page.on("websocket")) or a reload.
P1: ignore the prompt until expiresAt + 5 s; expect "Your co-op sign-in expired. Re-enter its password to recover.", no auto-mint; reload shows refusal or recovery UI.
P1 recovery: enter the seat password; same playerId, reconnected transport, working actions.
scenarios.expect: Absolute mintedAt, promptAppearedAt, renewedAt, expiredObservedAt and recoveredAt per profile.
scenarios.failsIf: Early or absent prompt; any automatic mint; renewal or recovery yields a different playerId without IDENTITY_CHANGED; storage replaced without reconnect; an expired bearer works after reconnect.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: Selectors frozen. Only this test calls test.setTimeout(75 * 60 * 1000); the config stays 30 s (Q2). The machine must not sleep. A lost tab is a FAIL.

scenarios.title: Operator revoke, then re-provision (seat 2)
steps: GM operator panel: select local-seat-2, "Revoke seat" (enabled only for an active seat): "Local seat revoke completed." and status revoked.
P2 original tab: reload; still joined as id2 (an issued bearer keeps its lifetime; no immediate eviction).
P2 new tab: choose Local seat 2 with the old password: "Local seat credentials were refused." (401), exactly one POST.
GM re-provisions local-seat-2 (label "Player 2b", new password): new playerId id2b, higher generation, differs from id2, id1 and the GM id.
scenarios.expect: Revocation takes effect at the next mint only.
scenarios.failsIf: The revoked seat mints; the live session is evicted at once; re-provision keeps id2; the old password still works.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: Selectors frozen; re-provisioning a revoked seat uses the plain "Provision seat" label (inactive seat).

scenarios.title: Guest reclaim with a new password (CF-LSC2OP-2), amended by G5
steps: P2 profile: "Forget choice and match sign-in; return to co-op entry" (the renewal region renders only inside the four-minute window or on a stored problem; see the IDENTITY_CHANGED gap); expect the three keys removed.
P2: choose Local seat 2 and join with the new password P2b.
Active-seat re-provision: with seat 2 active the operator panel shows "Re-provision seat (new identity)" and the confirmation checkbox; record the confirmation text and the new playerId id2c.
Ghost membership: id2 stays a member after re-provision.
Ordinary removal.
scenarios.expect: AMENDED by this admission (Q8): the join with the new identity is expected to be REFUSED by the host with campaign-tactical-seats-full while the ghost id2 and P1 hold the two tactical seats, and no ordinary-UI control removes a participant (G5). The spec records "refused: seats full" and "removal UI absent" as observations and makes no readmission or removal claim. If Root registers a GM removal UI leaf, steps 2-5 become the full sequence.
scenarios.failsIf: Active-seat re-provision proceeds without the confirmation; the old member is silently removed or transferred; the new identity is admitted without a free seat; reclaim leaves any of the three keys behind; a partial forget reports success.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: UNVERIFIED (U10, U11): the join-dialog text for AUTH_REJECTED campaign-tactical-seats-full, and whether the new identity is shown any member surface. The jsdom LS21c proves the refusal, the GM RemoveParticipant intent and the later admission.

scenarios.title: No token transfer (negative)
steps: At every checkpoint scan all three profiles for a wire token (URL, text, href, data-*, localStorage, sessionStorage keys other than the two per-match keys).
Accessible-name scan for copy|export|import|share with token|credential|bearer.

Harness audit: the spec source must not contain wireToken, sessionStorage.setItem, localStorage.setItem, addInitScript, page.clock, /api/e2e/ (except the N2 block), x-playwright-e2e-run-id, vault-identity or ttlMs.
scenarios.expect: No bearer outside its own key; no copy/export control.

scenarios.title: No test activator (negative)
steps: POST /api/e2e/token-ttl, POST /api/e2e/vault-identity, GET /api/e2e/fault, GET /api/e2e/performance-probe and GET /__playwright_e2e_ready__?runId=x return non-200 with and without a guessed run id header.
NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MODE and PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_RUN_ID are not defined in the spec env or the dedicated config.

scenarios.title: No server-wide identity switch (negative)
steps: The GM primary renewal returns the same GM playerId as S1.
/settings in P1 shows the single vault identity status, not a creation form or a selector; no seat label among vault identities.
Each profile keeps its own choice.
scenarios.failsIf: A selector or a changed GM id.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: Settings copy UNVERIFIED against the packaged UI.

scenarios.title: No implied role (negative)
steps: P1 and P2 show zero host-gm-review-surface and host-command-authority-private while the GM shows the host surface.
A profile that chose a seat but is not admitted has no member surfaces.
scenarios.failsIf: Any host surface on a guest.

scenarios.title: Denial versus throttle, no auto-retry (negative)
steps: After S5 and a 61 s quiet period, one wrong password for seat 2: "Local seat credentials were refused." (401).
Repeat to the lockout (5 failures): "Local seat requests are throttled. Retry after N seconds." (429 + Retry-After).
POST count equals user submits; after the lock expires the correct password succeeds.
scenarios.failsIf: POST count above submits; a wrong code.

scenarios.title: Secrecy and autofill (negative; CF-LSC2OP-4)
steps: Password inputs: autocomplete current-password (primary/renewal/join/create) and new-password (new seat password); unnamed; uncontrolled; empty right after submit.

Passwords and bearers absent from URLs, DOM text, localStorage, console, page errors, request URLs and every produced artifact (the spec searches its own record and report for each password value before writing).
scenarios.expect: Attribute checks automated; the interactive password-manager prompt is a recorded human gap (Step 8).
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: Playwright cannot observe a password-manager prompt.

scenarios.title: Authority restart (identity strict, recovery record-only)
steps: Record seats and bindings; end the installed app gracefully; relaunch with the same command and user-data dir; reload GM, P1, P2.
scenarios.expect: Seat rows and playerIds unchanged; no silent identity change. RECORDED, NOT ASSERTED: whether the campaign/match host recovered and whether stdout shows the InMemoryPlayerStore dev-only warning (CF-SMOKEA1-7).
scenarios.failsIf: Seats lost or regressed; ids changed; bearers swap identities.
scenarios.uiSurfaceStatus: A needed repair is a separate product owner, not this unit.

harness.architecture: Mode A. The operator installs the NSIS build and starts the installed app; the spec attaches to http://127.0.0.1:3001 only. Three Playwright chromium.launchPersistentContext profiles (gm, p1, p2) with distinct userDataDirs under LSC2P_RUN_DIR\profiles; they share only the origin string. No _electron.launch (single-instance lock and a fixed port).

e2e/local-seat-credentials.spec.ts (inline helpers only; serial; one top-level test per scenario; @soak on S3; writes only under LSC2P_RUN_DIR)
docs/releases/v2.2.0-local-seat-proof.md (disclaimer, procedure, the exact command, the JSON record copied verbatim, a per-scenario table, the artifact hash table, known gaps)

openQuestions.question: Real 60-minute TTLs for S3, or a shorter proof?
openQuestions.disposition: ADOPTED as the spec recommends: real time, about 62 minutes from T0. Every shortcut needs the E2E TTL override (a banned test activator) or an API-side ttlMs the UI never sends, so it would not be ordinary UI. Mutant M7 enforces it. Root or the owner may override.

openQuestions.question: Is a per-test test.setTimeout(75 min) acceptable under the unchanged 30-second config timeout?
openQuestions.disposition: ADOPTED: the config keeps timeout 30 s; only S3 calls test.setTimeout. Precedent e2e/coop-campaign-two-browser-journey.spec.ts:264 (180 s) and the root config comment that a per-test override is allowed.

openQuestions.question: Where do evidence artifacts live?
openQuestions.disposition: RESOLVED: external bundle. No trace, video, HAR or screenshot is tracked. Only SHA-256 values of proof-record.json, playwright-report.json, timeline.json and the screenshots appear in docs/releases/v2.2.0-local-seat-proof.md. The G-OWN freeze therefore covers the four registered lifecycle names plus the closure receipts, with no raw artifact leaf.

openQuestions.question: Does LSC-2 expose ghost membership and a removal path in the UI?
openQuestions.disposition: ANSWERED by the census of the merged LSC-2: NO. No roster or member list and no removal control exists in the campaign UI (RemoveParticipant appears in UI code only in components/campaign/coop/pendingProposalFromWire.ts, which renders proposals). Ghost membership is observable only as the host refusing a new identity with campaign-tactical-seats-full. This is G5; see Q8.

openQuestions.question: S5 cannot reach "GM readmission" or "ghost removal" in the ordinary UI: the new identity is refused (tactical seats full) and no removal control exists. Accept recording this, or register a GM removal UI leaf (a new product unit and PR)?
openQuestions.disposition: RECOMMENDED: accept and record. The packaged claim becomes: re-provision gives a new distinct playerId; the guest reclaims (mint succeeds); the host refuses the new identity while the ghost holds a seat; removal UI is absent; nothing more is claimed. A removal leaf would add at least one PR and break the 8-PR budget of Step 2, so it needs an owner answer. This admission amends S5 accordingly and adds mutant M8.
